supporting_quotes: Dubai, Almaty and Jersey City, [October 7, 2026] – VEON Ltd. ("VEON") (NASDAQ: VEON), a global digital operator, and Amdocs (NASDAQ: DOX), a leading provider of software and services to communications and media companies, today announced a 10-year strategic agreement.

Under the agreement, Amdocs will run and continuously modernize VEON's core technology operations, accelerate its strategy as a digital operator, and provide long-term cost predictability across its IT operations in Eurasia.
